pages.text: $(thing)European Corn Borer$() ($(o)Ostrinia nubilalis$()), insect.$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Hosts:$() maize, sorghum.$(li)$(thing)Spreads:$() migration, crop residue.$(li)$(thing)Favoured by$() 15-32 °C (best 25 °C).
